get.description: Requires current platform.integration.read, exact server-validated context and recent TOTP AAL2 (15 minutes). Writes and tests additionally require effective PLATFORM_OWNER. Secrets are encrypted with deployment key material and separate Google AAD; reads/history never return secret values or ciphertext. Optimistic If-Match and actor-scoped idempotency protect writes. The governance fence requires a surviving verified password-and-TOTP Owner. Current settings are consumed by the existing state/nonce/PKCE OIDC and explicit-link flows; version changes invalidate in-flight callbacks. Signup/domain policy is rechecked in the identity commit transaction. No email auto-link or administrator grant. Existing authenticated sessions retain their session policy.

Secrets are encrypted with deployment key material and separate Google AAD; reads/history never return secret values or ciphertext. Optimistic If-Match and actor-scoped idempotency protect writes. The governance fence requires a surviving verified password-and-TOTP Owner. Current settings are consumed by the existing state/nonce/PKCE OIDC and explicit-link flows; version changes invalidate in-flight callbacks. Signup/domain policy is rechecked in the identity commit transaction. No email auto-link or administrator grant. Existing authenticated sessions retain their session policy. Bounded Google JWKS probe only. Reachable keys do not verify client credentials; complete an actual OIDC sign-in. At most three claims per actor in ten minutes; uncertain/crashed claims remain pending without automatic retry. No secret is sent to this probe.
